items.title: Malik Beasley agrees to plead guilty to gambling charges
items.text: Veteran NBA guard Malik Beasley, who was indicted earlier this year for federal gambling crimes, will be revising his not-guilty plea.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs closing in on 6,000 scrimmage yards and 60 touchdowns in four NFL seasons
items.text: Gibbs is set to become the third player in NFL history to reach those milestones within his first four years in the league.

items.title: Packers-Lions does 24.67 million in Sunday's late window
items.text: The NFL's late-afternoon window on Sundays continues to rack up big audiences.

items.title: Joey Porter Jr. on his critics: They'll be quiet soon
items.text: Upset about not getting a contract extension before the season, cornerback Joey Porter Jr. didn't play in four games with the Steelers.

items.title: Steelers-Saints in Paris generates 7.7 million on Sunday morning
items.text: Sunday morning football doesn't do the same numbers as Sunday afternoon or evening (or Monday night or Thursday) football, but it does better than anything else on TV at that time of day.

items.title: Alabama dismisses CB Dre Kirkpatrick Jr. after arrest for doxxing, harassing police officer
items.text: Alabama cornerback Dre Kirkpatrick Jr., the son of former NFL cornerback Dre Kirkpatrick, has been dismissed from the team.

items.title: Jared Goff backs Dan Campbell's decision to go for it deep in Lions' own end
items.text: The Lions went for it on fourth-and-1 in a tie game with 4:53 left, and Jahmyr Gibbs was stopped for a 2-yard loss.

items.title: Chiefs-Seahawks attracts 26.3 million viewers on Sunday night
items.text: Even though the game itself was far from compelling, the matchup of a pair of former AFC West rivals delivered big numbers on Sunday night.

items.title: Packers LB Zaire Franklin won't play Thursday night
items.text: Packers linebacker Zaire Franklin will miss another game.

items.title: Montez Sweat on suspension: What happened, happened and I'm moving forward
items.text: Defensive end Montez Sweat's two-game suspension ended after last Thursday's win over the Patriots and he addressed his absence from the team's facility on Tuesday.

items.title: Cowboys waive RB Emari Demercado
items.text: The Cowboys waived running back Emari Demercado on Tuesday, the team announced.

items.text: The Seahawks and 49ers hope to benefit in the near term from the trades they made with the Colts on Tuesday, but another team could wind up as a long-term winner.

items.text: The Cardinals placed wide receiver Jalen Brooks on season-ending injured reserve, the team announced Tuesday.

items.title: Report: Lamar Jackson is expected to return Sunday
items.text: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has not played since Oct. 4, missing the past three games with a high ankle sprain.

items.title: Dave Canales knows opposing offenses are excited to game plan vs. Panthers' run defense
items.text: The Panthers have the worst run defense in the NFL, and head coach Dave Canales knows what that means for opposing teams game planning against them.

items.title: Deion Sanders says offer of $50,000 to critics was "a joke"
items.text: Colorado coach Deion Sanders has addressed the comments made recently by Christopher "Uncle" Neely regarding a supposed willingness to pay critics $50,000 to not mention his name.

items.title: Packers list Matthew Golden as out of practice Tuesday
items.text: The Packers turned in their second estimated injury report of the week on Tuesday and it showed no change in status for wide receiver Matthew Golden.

items.title: Colts place CB Cam Taylor-Britt on IR, sign CB Kenneth Harris from practice squad

items.title: Seahawks announce Quenton Nelson trade, waive G Christian Haynes
items.text: Guard Quenton Nelson will need to pass a physical to finalize his move to the Seahawks, but the team has already made room for him on their 53-man roster.

items.title: Giants to sign RB Gregory Desrosiers off Chargers practice squad
items.text: The Giants will be without Tyrone Tracy for at least the next four games because of a hamstring injury and they'll pluck a player from another team to fill the opening on their active roster.
